title: A JPA entity on javax.persistence + javax.validation must move to jakarta.* (and Hibernate 5→6)
notes: Every javax.persistence.* and javax.validation.* import moves to jakarta.* under Spring Boot 3 / Jakarta EE 9. That forces Hibernate 5→6 (which targets jakarta.persistence). The invariant (quantity>=1, sku not null) must survive the annotation move unchanged.
